ArgonTest.Name: Tuple projection move then use sibling
ArgonTest.InputSource:
module _
import Argon.Core::*
record MyRecord value: String end
proc takeRecord(value: MyRecord): () = ()
proc moveThenUseSibling(a: MyRecord, b: MyRecord): () do takeRecord a puts b.value end
proc main(): () do let tupleValue: (MyRecord, MyRecord) = MyRecord { value: "1" }, MyRecord { value: "2" } moveThenUseSibling tupleValue end
